tool.name: HumaninFinder
tool.description: Evolutionary discovery tool for Humanin-like peptides (sORFs) using a Hybrid AI approach

param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Input DNA sequences
param.help: Mitochondrial or Genomic DNA in FASTA format.

param.name: threshold
param.label: Confidence threshold
param.help: Minimum score to report a candidate.

param.name: table
param.label: Genetic code table
param.help: NCBI Genetic Code ID (e.g., 2 for Vertebrate Mitochondrial).

param.name: rescue
param.label: Enable Rescue Mode
param.help: Rescues degenerated or non-canonical peptides via sliding window.

param.name: hmm
param.label: Enable HMM Locus Detection
param.help: Uses HMM to find the Humanin locus footprint.

tool.help: **HumaninFinder** is a professional evolutionary discovery tool for Humanin-like peptides (sORFs). It combines ESM-2 structural embeddings with biophysical properties to identify functional, non-canonical, and pseudogenic sequences.
